# Get current green block positions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Compute center of each green block for clicking
click_positions = []
for gb in green_blocks:

# Batch click all remaining green blocks
mouse_actions = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in click_positions]
result = action(mouse_actions)
print(f"\nResult: {result}")
print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"Done: {result.get('done')}")

# Check remaining green blocks
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
nodes2 = seg2['nodes']
remaining = [n for n in nodes2 if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Remaining green blocks: {len(remaining)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
